source.quote: As of the same date, issued shares and shares outstanding totaled 5,764,191,903 for common shares and 802,371,203 for preferred shares. ... VI. Outstanding shares 5,764,191,903 802,371,203 6,566,563,106 -

notes: Two classes, each priced on its own Korea Exchange line in KRW: common shares as 005930.KS and non-voting preferred shares as 005935.KS. Counts are shares outstanding (net of 82,086,705 common treasury shares; no preferred treasury shares) from the 2026 half-year business report (June 30, 2026), the latest Samsung has published in English (no third-quarter report is on its IR site yet). The preferred shares are included under the coordinator rule for participating non-voting shares (as for Volkswagen, Porsche and Roche): they have no fixed or limited claim, receive the common dividend plus an extra 1% of par per year, and share in profits like common stock. Preferred stock with a fixed or limited claim would be left out.
